title: Warm Toasted Russian Almonds Toast
description: A savory, crispy, Russian dish featuring almond essence, perfect for meal prep, ovo-vegetarian-friendly, and cooked in a cataplana.

ingredients.name: Whole wheat bread
ingredients.notes: any type of bread will do, but whole wheat is recommended for better nutrition.

ingredients.name: Almond essence
ingredients.notes: almond extract can be used as a substitute.

ingredients.name: Unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: can be replaced with other plant-based butters.

ingredients.name: Grated cheddar cheese
ingredients.notes: can be omitted for a cheese-free option.

instructions: Preheat the cataplana over medium heat.
Add a small amount of olive oil to the cataplana and grease it.
Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and place them inside the cataplana.
Drizzle the almond essence over the bread.
Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the bread.
Add the grated cheddar cheese over the almonds.
Add the minced garlic and chopped parsley over the cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the cataplana over medium heat and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted.
